COUNTRY_PICKER.TITLE: Where should we host your WhatsApp?
COUNTRY_PICKER.SUBTITLE: Your number lives on a datacentre closest to you, with a residential IP to protect it from bans. Every WhatsApp inbox on this account is served from the same region.
COUNTRY_PICKER.CLICK_A_COUNTRY: Click a country on the map to pick your region
COUNTRY_PICKER.RESOLVE_FAILED: Couldn't reach the server in that region. Try another country or retry in a moment.

HOOKUP.TITLE: WhatsApp Business
HOOKUP.SUBTITLE: Download WhatsApp Business from the App or Play Store.
HOOKUP.IOS_INSTRUCTIONS: Open WhatsApp, go to Settings, tap Linked Devices, then Link a Device.
HOOKUP.ANDROID_INSTRUCTIONS: Open WhatsApp, tap the menu, choose Linked Devices, then Link a Device.
HOOKUP.QR_ERROR: Couldn't prepare your WhatsApp connection. You can continue and set it up later.
HOOKUP.PAIRING_CODE_HINT: Enter this code on your phone to link.

ANDROID_STEPS.1: Open WhatsApp on your primary Android phone.
ANDROID_STEPS.2: Tap More (three vertical dots) > Linked devices > Link a device > Link with phone number instead.
ANDROID_STEPS.3: Enter the eight-character code from your companion device on your primary phone.

IOS_STEPS.1: Open WhatsApp on your primary iPhone.
IOS_STEPS.2: Go to the Settings tab, then tap Linked devices > Link device > Link with phone number instead.
IOS_STEPS.4: Follow the on-screen instructions to verify with biometrics, or enter your phone's unlock PIN.
IOS_STEPS.5: Enter the eight-character code from your companion device on your primary phone.
